decision: Meaning and consequence of the three-day paid reservation deadline

options.A: Three-day checkpoint with manual seller action and no automatic final end
options.B: Automatic cancellation at three days unless pickup, bilateral extension or a delivery dispute applies
options.C: Three-day pickup period followed by a disclosed finite resolution window, then closure if unresolved and uncontested

diversity_note: Three models (gpt-6.1-sol, gpt-6-astra, gpt-6-sol), distinct coordination, financial reliability and product/operations lenses. Same model family, shared evidence and no local outcome data; partial independence.
